verification.runtime_check: Started uvicorn app.main:create_app --factory twice (ports 8765, 8766) with LOG_DB_PATH and LOG_UPLOADS_DIR pointed at a scratchpad temp dir, drove all flows via httpx, restarted and re-checked persistence, then deleted logs. All servers stopped and the temp data removed. No logs.db or uploads/ was created in the project root. One driver-script typo (my P() arity) aborted the delete section of the first run; delete was re-run separately in a second run and verified (200, files removed, GET 404, delete of nonexistent id 404).
verification.main_py_check: app/main.py as currently on disk is 265 lines, parses, and is coherent and complete: imports, create_app factory, schema, size middleware, helpers, create/list/get/edit/delete routes, static and uploads mounts, index route, return app. No truncation seen. Tests and live run exercised it successfully.
verification.self_critique: Not tested: the frontend in a browser (JS logic, confirm dialog, error rendering), the 26 MB Content-Length middleware path, a DB row with a missing file on edit or delete, concurrent requests, and failure injection mid-write for orphan cleanup. The 413 on the 5 MB+1 body relies on the server, which is fine locally; behaviour on other ASGI servers may differ. Windows-only run.
